messages.content: Who invented the theory of relativity and in which year?

function.name: science_history_get_invention
function.description: Retrieve the inventor and year of invention based on the invention's name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

want_year.description: Return the year of invention if set to true.

message.content:
**Inventor:** Albert Einstein  
**Year(s) of publication:**  
- **Special Theory of Relativity** – first presented in his 1905 paper “Zur Elektrodynamik bewegter Körper” (published in *Annalen der Physik*).  
- **General Theory of Relativity** – completed and published in 1915 in *Annalen der Physik*.

So, Einstein introduced the core ideas of relativity in 1905, and the full, modern formulation of the theory was finalized in 1915.
